We need to determine crimes. Facts: group organized illegal excavation of cultural relics (ancient tombs) on private/company land. This is illegal excavation of cultural relics, which under Chinese law is a crime of "非法买卖文物罪" or "盗掘古墓罪"? Actually Chinese Criminal Law has article 322: "盗掘古墓葬罪" (illegal excavation of ancient tombs). Also "破坏文物罪". The act is illegal excavation of tombs, which is a crime of "盗掘古墓罪". The law: Criminal Law article 322: "盗掘古墓葬或者破坏文物的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the charge is "盗掘古墓". The instruction: list statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "盗掘古墓". If also "破坏文物" maybe separate? The act includes excavation (盗掘) and also damage to cultural relics (破坏文物). Usually the charge is "盗掘古墓罪" which covers both. Might also be "破坏文物罪". The facts: they excavated tombs, causing damage. The appropriate charge is "盗掘古墓". Possibly also "破坏文物". The instruction: if multiple distinct illegal acts mapping to separate statutory offenses, list each. Here the act is illegal excavation (盗掘古墓) which is a specific offense. The damage to cultural relics is part of that offense. So likely only one charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗掘古墓<eoa>
